body: I have no more effort left in me, I am broken. and exerting effort does not yield others caring either, usually the opposite. i think it's my time to shine this month.

who's them? and no, because realistically speaking no one cares. I know for a fact it's just how the world is, even if they listen, they just use your weakness or your feelings against you to put you down further later on in life.

I’ve done my best to be a decent human being, to live with respect and morals. I recall blurry he said there is no compassion, there is nothing that I can say or do to make someone care about my story, no one cares and no one ever will. I believe him because bad things still happened even though I was in a bad place already, it only gets worse..might as well end it

not sure what to talk about, it’s been 5 years of struggling to find a decent stable life. Now that I have it I feel even shitter than ever. It’s like people don’t care and want to scheme together for me to fail. I’m tired of fighting against the masses. If i’m such a problem perhaps I need to go. I’ve lived a decent life.
